ORDINANCE VIII OF 1999
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1999
INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
An Ordinance further to amend the
Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 27th May, 1999]
No.F.2(1)/99-Pub., dated
27-5-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Industrial Relations (Amendment) Ordinance, 1999.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 1, Ordinance XXIII of 1969

ORDINANCE VIII OF 1999
ORDINANCE VIII OF 1999
INDUSTRIAL RELATIONS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1999
An Ordinance further to amend the
Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969
[Gazette of Pakistan Extraordinary, Part I, 27th May, 1999]
No.F.2(1)/99-Pub., dated
27-5-1999.--The following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published
for general information.
2. Amendment of section 1, Ordinance XXIII of 1969.--In the
Industrial Relations Ordinance, 1969 (XXIII of 1969), in section 1, in
subsection (3),--
(a) in clause (h) for the full-stop
at the end the semi-colon and word :1'" shall be substituted; and
(b) after clause (h) amended as
aforesaid the following new clause shall be added. namely:--
"(1) by the Karachi Electric Supply Corporation."
